insert into lot_master (comp_cd, lot_no, item_id, origin, qty_created, unit_cd, wo_id, supplier_cust_id, supplier_lot_no, occurred_at, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.lotNo}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.origin}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.woId}, #{f.supplierCustId}, #{f.supplierLotNo}, #{f.occurredAt}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning lot_id

insert into lot_genealogy (comp_cd, parent_lot_id, child_lot_id, rel_type, qty, unit_cd, wo_id, wo_proc_id, equip_id, reason, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by, reversal_of_id, change_id) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.parentLotId}, #{f.childLotId}, #{f.relType}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.woId}, #{f.woProcId}, #{f.equipId}, #{f.reason}, #{f.occurredAt}, #{f.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{f.performedBy}, #{f.reversalOfId}, #{f.changeId}) returning gen_id
mapper.sql: g.gen_id, g.parent_lot_id, p.lot_no as parent_lot_no, g.child_lot_id, ch.lot_no as child_lot_no, g.rel_type, trim_scale(g.qty)::text as qty, g.unit_cd, g.wo_id, g.wo_proc_id, g.equip_id, w.wo_no, g.reason, g.occurred_at, g.recorded_at, g.entry_method, g.recorded_by, k.worker_nm as performed_by, g.reversal_of_id, g.change_id, exists (select 1 from lot_genealogy r where r.reversal_of_id = g.gen_id) as reversed

from lot_genealogy g join lot_master p on p.lot_id = g.parent_lot_id join lot_master ch on ch.lot_id = g.child_lot_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = g.wo_id left join mst_worker k on k.worker_id = g.performed_by

mapper.select: with recursive t (lvl, lot_id, via_lot_id, rel_type, path, cyc) as ( select 1, g.parent_lot_id, g.child_lot_idg.child_lot_id, g.parent_lot_id, g.rel_type, array[#{lotId}::bigint, g.parent_lot_idg.child_lot_id], false from lot_genealogy g where g.child_lot_idg.parent_lot_id = #{lotId} and union select t.lvl + 1, g.parent_lot_id, g.child_lot_idg.child_lot_id, g.parent_lot_id, g.rel_type, t.path || g.parent_lot_idg.child_lot_id, g.parent_lot_idg.child_lot_id = any(t.path) from t join lot_genealogy g on g.child_lot_idg.parent_lot_id = t.lot_id where not t.cyc and t.lvl < #{depth} and ), capped as (select * from t limit #{limit}) select c.lvl, c.lot_id, m.lot_no, c.via_lot_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, m.origin, c.rel_type, (select trim_scale(sum(g.qty))::text from lot_genealogy g where g.parent_lot_id = c.lot_idc.via_lot_id and g.child_lot_id = c.via_lot_idc.lot_id and g.rel_type = c.rel_type) as qty, (select pl.unit_cd from lot_master pl where pl.lot_id = c.lot_idc.via_lot_id) as unit_cd, w.wo_no, m.supplier_lot_no, m.hold_yn, c.cyc as cycle from capped c join lot_master m on m.lot_id = c.lot_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = m.item_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = m.wo_id order by c.path
